_doc: Era unlocks and Era III art data. unlock_flags: era number -> the story flag that opens it (EraManager.unlock_from_flags). era3: the post-game region opened after Era II and the designs of its starting set, drawn by tools/art/gen_era3.py into art/era3/spirlings/. finale_flags: era flag -> the flag the era's post-game finale sets (EraManager.mark_finales). Era III's region adds its own entry for era3_finale_done when it lands; Halcyra (data/region4.json) waits on that flag; Quivermoor (data/region5.json, Era V) waits on era4_finale_done and sets era5_finale_done. regions: post-game region -> its era (EraManager.region_era), for regions after the story. ring_caps: era number -> highest ring a Spirling can grow to once that era is open (GameState.ring_ceiling; Era I and II stay at Spirling.MAX_LEVEL 60; Era III also stays at 60 until its region sets its own rings (raise its value then); Era IV Halcyra opens 96 for its rings 78 to 96; Era V Quivermoor opens 108 for its rings 92 to 108; the last value equals Spirling.ERA_MAX_LEVEL). XP keeps the same power curve (Spirling.xp_for_level), so every ring past 60 costs more than the one before.
